what: Exhaustive Hamming balls of radius 7 around the two census certificates that produced every known scheme outside the 2,367.
method: compute/ballc.c walks all sign vectors within Hamming distance 7 of the seed on that certificate's own (integer-certified) triangulation and emits one witness per distinct scheme fingerprint; each witness is decoded to its scheme string on the exact Python complex and diffed against the census.
conclusion: Within Hamming distance 7 of these two certificates the eight schemes certified in the previous session are exactly the schemes outside the published 2,367 -- there is no ninth.
